title: Lifting strongly graded rings via overgroups
summary: Motivated by lifting problems for principal bundles, we study the following algebraic problem. Let $\smash{\widehat{G}}$ be a group with identity element $e$, let $G \leq \smash{\widehat{G}}$, and let $S$ be a strongly $G$-graded unital ring with principal component $R:=S_e$. We ask whether the given grading extends to a strong $\smash{\widehat{G}}$-grading without altering its $G$-homogeneous components.
